title: Splitting moves a no-charge line with its mark and notes on both
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, billable, with line 1 of 2.0 hours at $120.00 an hour and line 2 of 1.5 hours with one stock part costing $40.00, line 2 marked No Charge under Goodwill.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Split work order 1, moving line 2 to a new work order.
  3. Open the new work order.
  4. Hover over the "No Charge" chip on line 2 of the new work order.
  5. Open the Notes tab.
  6. Open work order 1.
  7. Open the Notes tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • A new work order is created.

Step 3:

  • Line 2 shows the chip "No Charge" on the new work order.
  • The chip shows only the words "No Charge", with no category name in it.

Step 4:

  • A tooltip reads "Category: Goodwill".

Step 5:

  • The note about line 2 is there.

Step 6:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 7:

  • The same note is on work order 1 as well.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.4 (13 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 14 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-E1: “If a no-charge line is split to another work order with the existing split, it keeps its mark, category and original fields on the new work order; the note of S12-R6 is written on both.”
  • S12-R3: “A no-charge line shows the chip "No Charge" next to its title on the lines table, in Tech View and on mobile, with the tooltip "Category: [category]" on hover, as the work order badge has (S2-R16); the category itself is not printed in the chip; Rate, Total and every part on it show $0.00; Margin shows nothing. Hours, technician, status, approval, parts ordering, picking, receiving, clock-ins, notes, inspections and the story work as on any line. The original work order and line are not shown on the line; they are in the notes, the Audit Log, the report and the hub record.”
